fields.name: magic
fields.doc: `ONWR`, little-endian.

fields.name: version
fields.doc: The FORMAT_VERSION this dish was written at.

fields.name: section_count
fields.doc: Entries in the directory that follows.

fields.name: flags
fields.doc: Bit 0: every offset is UTF-16.

fields.name: usfm_version
fields.doc: The declared \usfm ladder index, or NONE.

fields.name: source_length
fields.doc: The source's length, in the offset space.

fields.name: source_hash
fields.doc: xxh3-64 of the source bytes.

envelope.doc: One entry per section, in SECTION order.

fields.name: at
fields.doc: Byte offset of the section in the dish.

fields.name: len
fields.doc: Its length in bytes.

fields.name: start
fields.doc: Where the token begins.

fields.name: end
fields.doc: Where it ends. Spans TILE the document, so ends ascend too.

fields.name: kind
fields.doc: Packed TokenKind; bit 4 is the per-shape spelling bit.

fields.name: marker
fields.doc: Row in the marker table; 0 is UNRESOLVED.

fields.name: level
fields.doc: The trailing number as spelled: 2 for `\q2`, 1 for `\tc1`, 0 for a bare `\q`. The row's `numbering` says whether it is a nesting level or a column index.

fields.name: flags
fields.doc: `TOKEN_DELIMITER_FOLDED` | `TOKEN_BLANK`. Also rounds the row to 12 bytes, so every row's `start` and `end` land aligned for a typed-array view over a 4-aligned section.

fields.name: token
fields.doc: The opening marker's token index; u32::MAX on the root.

fields.name: child_from
fields.doc: Start of this node's range in the child arena.

fields.name: child_to
fields.doc: End of that range. Ranges are neither contiguous nor monotonic.

fields.name: reason
fields.doc: CloseReason: Explicit, Implicit, Recovery, Eof.

fields.name: ctx
fields.doc: The stamped SpecContext.

fields.name: code
fields.doc: Index into the lint catalog.

fields.name: from
fields.doc: The anchor's start.

fields.name: to
fields.doc: The anchor's end.

fields.name: second_from
fields.doc: The other party's start, or NONE.

fields.name: second_to
fields.doc: The other party's end, or NONE.

fields.name: aux
fields.doc: The code's aux integer; its meaning is the catalog row's.

fields.name: fix
fields.doc: Index into the fix section, or NONE.

fields.name: edit_from
fields.doc: Start of this fix's range in the edit section.

fields.name: edit_to
fields.doc: End of that range.

fields.name: from
fields.doc: Where the replacement starts.

fields.name: to
fields.doc: Where it ends; equal to `from` for a pure insertion.

fields.name: text_from
fields.doc: Start of the inserted bytes in the fix-text section.

fields.name: text_len
fields.doc: Their length. Zero is a pure deletion.

fields.name: start
fields.doc: Where the chapter begins.

fields.name: end
fields.doc: Where it ends.

fields.name: token
fields.doc: The `\c` marker's token index; NONE on the front-matter row.

fields.name: designator
fields.doc: The number's own token index, or NONE. `\c` opens no node, so this is the only route from a chapter to its designator.

fields.name: label_start
fields.doc: The designator as written (`12b`), minus its folded delimiter. Empty at the marker's end when there is none; 0..0 on row 0.

fields.name: label_end
fields.doc: Where the label ends.

fields.name: number
fields.doc: The number read, or 0 for absent or malformed.

fields.name: at
fields.doc: Where the anchor sits.

fields.name: token
fields.doc: The `\v` marker's token index.

fields.name: designator
fields.doc: The number's own token index, or NONE. `\v` opens no node, so this is the only route from a verse to its designator.

fields.name: label_start
fields.doc: The designator as written (`6a`, `1,3,5`), minus its folded delimiter. Empty at the marker's end when there is none.

fields.name: label_end
fields.doc: Where the label ends.

fields.name: members_from
fields.doc: This verse's first row in the member arena.

fields.name: members_len
fields.doc: How many members it covers; 0 when the designator is absent or malformed.

fields.name: chapter
fields.doc: The enclosing chapter's number.

fields.name: first
fields.doc: First verse named; 0 when the designator is absent or malformed.

fields.name: last
fields.doc: Last verse named — a bridge `\v 5-7` names 5 through 7.

fields.name: from
fields.doc: The member's first number.

fields.name: from_segment_start
fields.doc: The segment written after it (`a` in `12a`); empty when none.

fields.name: from_segment_end
fields.doc: Where that segment ends.

fields.name: to
fields.doc: Its last number; equal to `from` for a single place. Kept as written.

fields.name: to_segment_start
fields.doc: The segment after the last number; empty when none.

fields.name: to_segment_end
fields.doc: Where that segment ends.
